findings.title: StreamIdleTimeoutError message promises a retry on paths that do not auto-retry
findings.location: src/core/task/streamIdleTimeout.ts (StreamIdleTimeoutError constructor); surfaced via src/core/condense/index.ts (condense_api_failed) and Task.attemptApiRequest api_req_failed ask
findings.fix: Change the message to end with '; the request was aborted.' and let callers that actually retry (backoffAndAnnounce paths) add retry wording; condense falls back to truncation and the non-auto-approval ask waits for a Retry click.
